description: Fix zero score issues in AI scoring pipeline by improving error handling, validation, and retry logic in Groq API integration and report generation
steps: Add better error handling in server/src/services/ai/groq.service.js for API failures and malformed responses
Improve validation in candidateAnalysis.service.js to catch zero scores and invalid report structures
Add retry logic in server/src/services/report/report.service.js for failed AI analysis with exponential backoff
Add logging to track Groq API call success/failure rates and response validation issues
Update report generation to automatically retry when overallScore is 0 and transcript data exists
acceptance_criteria: Groq API failures are logged with detailed error information and retry automatically
Zero scores trigger automatic retry when transcript segments are available
Report validation catches malformed AI responses and marks them for retry
Scoring pipeline provides non-zero scores when transcript data is substantial
verification: Generate reports for interviews with substantial transcript data - scores should be non-zero
Check server logs for Groq API error handling during report generation
Verify automatic retry occurs when initial report generation produces zero scores
Test report generation with mock API failures to confirm retry logic
findings: COMPLETED: Enhanced error handling in Groq service with detailed logging and structured error messages. Added validation in analysis services to detect zero scores with substantial content and trigger retries. Implemented exponential backoff retry logic in report generation. Added comprehensive logging for debugging API calls and validation issues. Zero score detection triggers automatic retry when transcript data is available.
